name: Time Management Fundamentals
instructions: List everything you need to do today, then rank each item by real importance, not just urgency.
Schedule your top 1-3 priorities during your highest-energy hours of the day, not whenever there happens to be a gap.
Batch small, similar tasks (replying to messages, quick admin) into one block instead of scattering them through the day.
Watch today's video for more concrete time management techniques.
